protocol.name: hyprland_global_shortcuts_v1
protocol.description: This protocol allows a client to register triggerable actions, meant to be global shortcuts.

interface.name: hyprland_global_shortcuts_manager_v1
interface.description: This object is a manager which offers requests to create global shortcuts.

request.name: register_shortcut
request.description: Register a new global shortcut. The keybinding is dealt with by the compositor. A duplicate app_id + id combination is ignored.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: a unique id for the shortcut

arg.name: description
arg.summary: a description of the shortcut action

arg.name: trigger_description
arg.summary: a preferred trigger for the shortcut

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager remain valid until destroyed.

interface.name: hyprland_global_shortcut_v1
interface.description: This object represents a single shortcut.

arg.name: tv_sec_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp

arg.name: tv_sec_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp

arg.name: tv_sec_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp

arg.name: tv_sec_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp
